meta.title: Lowgear Cycle Works | Bike repair in Hackney
meta.description: Bike servicing, same-day repairs, wheel building and steel frame restoration in a railway arch off Mare Street, Hackney. Book a service or just turn up.

rationale: A workshop in a railway arch suits the Swiss poster approach: plain white, one hot signal red, heavy grotesque type and numbered lists read like a workshop board. Services are a big numbered index and a price ledger because customers want to see what is done and roughly what it costs. Rules and numbers do all the structuring, with no decoration.

props.label: What we do
props.title: Four jobs, done properly
props.intro: Dami and Rosa do all the work themselves. No middlemen, no queue of unknown hands.

props.label: About
props.title: Couriers, commuters and old steel
paragraphs: Lowgear is Dami and Rosa, working out of a railway arch in Hackney. A lot of our customers are couriers and commuters who cannot be without their bike for long, so we work to get it back to you the same day.
We do the everyday jobs well: servicing, punctures, brakes. We also build wheels properly, by hand, and we restore old steel frames. That last one is the part Dami loves, and it shows.
Come in, show us the bike, and we will tell you straight what it needs.
props.pullQuote: Come in, show us the bike.

items.a: No. You can turn up at the arch. Booking a slot just means we have time set aside for you.

items.q: Can you fix a puncture while I wait?
items.a: Yes. Punctures and brake fixes are done while you wait.

items.q: Will I get my bike back today?
items.a: For most repairs, yes. Wheel building and frame restoration take longer and we will agree a time with you.

items.q: Do you work on old steel bikes?
items.a: Yes, and we love to. Bring it in and we will talk through what it needs.
